answer: Keeping 118 aliases alive hence means 118 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the nectar quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the opal log reveals the live set and the quill audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 759 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
